auditScope: Client-side React components + TypeScript API handlers
summary: Moderate security posture. Backend properly implements session auth via Auth0 with RLS enforcement. Client components have structural issues with auth token handling in API requests. No critical hardcoded secrets detected.

vulnerabilities.title: Auth token retrieved but not sent in API request
vulnerabilities.description: getAccessTokenSilently() is called but the token is never added to request headers. The fetch call includes 'Content-Type': 'application/json' but missing Authorization header. This breaks per-request auth verification.
vulnerabilities.impact: Server-side auth validation may fail or be skipped. API calls could be intercepted without authentication verification.

vulnerabilities.title: Auth token not sent in county validation request
vulnerabilities.description: Token is retrieved with getAccessTokenSilently() but not included in the fetch request headers.
vulnerabilities.impact: Unauthenticated API call to validation endpoint.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Include Authorization header with Bearer token

vulnerabilities.title: Auth token retrieved but not sent to /api/documents/generate
vulnerabilities.description: Token is retrieved with getAccessTokenSilently() but not passed to the API endpoint that handles payment and document generation.
vulnerabilities.impact: Payment authorization and user identity verification may fail. Critical for payment processing security.

vulnerabilities.title: Auth token not sent in evidence upload request
vulnerabilities.description: Token is obtained via getAccessTokenSilently() but FormData request doesn't include Authorization header.
vulnerabilities.impact: Evidence uploads could be performed without proper user authentication verification.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Add Authorization header to fetch: headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`

vulnerabilities.title: Auth token not sent to /api/payment/create-intent
vulnerabilities.description: Token is retrieved but not sent with payment intent creation request. This is critical for payment processing security.
vulnerabilities.impact: Payment intent creation could be spoofed. Attacker could create intents for other users or manipulate amounts.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Include Bearer token in Authorization header

vulnerabilities.title: Client-side file type validation can be bypassed
vulnerabilities.description: MIME type is validated only on the client. An attacker can modify the MIME type to bypass the check and upload malicious files.
vulnerabilities.impact: Malicious files (executables, scripts) could be uploaded and potentially executed if server doesn't validate.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Implement server-side magic-byte verification (first 4-8 bytes). CLAUDE.md mentions 'magic-byte sniff' so ensure it's implemented on server.

vulnerabilities.title: Error messages rendered without sanitization (dev only)
vulnerabilities.description: Error stack traces and error info are rendered directly to DOM in development mode. If error contains user-controlled content, could lead to XSS.
vulnerabilities.impact: Low - only in development mode. But if error object contains unsanitized user data, could lead to XSS.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Sanitize error messages or ensure only safe error data is displayed. Consider using JSON.stringify with safe replacer.

vulnerabilities.title: Detailed error information sent to monitoring service
vulnerabilities.description: Error details including stack traces are logged to external monitoring service (window.logError). No filtering of sensitive data visible.
vulnerabilities.impact: Stack traces and URLs could leak sensitive application internals to monitoring service.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Filter sensitive data before sending to external services. Implement whitelist of safe fields.

vulnerabilities.title: Potential race condition in redirect guard
vulnerabilities.description: Uses a Ref to prevent duplicate loginWithRedirect calls, but timing between state updates and redirect completion could cause race conditions.
vulnerabilities.impact: In rare cases, multiple redirects could be initiated, causing auth flow issues.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Use a state variable instead of Ref, or add a timeout to reset the guard.

vulnerabilities.title: Client-side skipPayment flag in development
vulnerabilities.description: skipPayment: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development' is sent to server. If server trusts this, attackers could bypass payment.
vulnerabilities.impact: If server uses this flag to skip payment validation, serious payment processing vulnerability.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Never trust client-provided payment status. Server must independently verify payment state from Stripe.

strengths.title: Backend Session Authentication
strengths.description: Proper implementation of Auth0 integration with @auth0/nextjs-auth0. Sessions use secure SameSite cookies.

strengths.title: Row-Level Security (RLS)
strengths.description: Database RLS policies enforce data isolation at the database layer (migrations 010/012/013). withRLSContext properly sets per-request session variables.

strengths.title: CSRF Protection
strengths.description: Middleware implements Origin checking for state-changing requests and exempts webhooks. SameSite cookies provide defense-in-depth.

strengths.title: Parameterized SQL Queries
strengths.description: CLAUDE.md enforces use of lib/db.ts query() helper which uses parameterized queries. No raw SQL concatenation visible.

strengths.title: Server-Side Validation
strengths.description: CLAUDE.md states 'Server-side pricing only'. Zod validation on Route Handlers ensures untrusted input is validated server-side.

strengths.title: No Hardcoded Secrets
strengths.description: No API keys, passwords, or secrets found in client code. Environment variables properly used.

recommendations.details: Add auth tokens to all API requests. Create a wrapper function for fetch that automatically includes Authorization headers. Affects ChatInterface.js, CountyValidationInput.js, GenerateButton.js, EvidenceUploadModal.js, PaymentModal.js.
Ensure /api/payment/create-intent and /api/documents/generate validate user identity and payment status from Stripe, not from client-supplied data. Never trust skipPayment flag.
Verify magic bytes (first 4-8 bytes) of uploaded files match expected format. CLAUDE.md mentions 'magic-byte sniff' — confirm implementation exists in /api/evidence/upload.
Filter sensitive information from ErrorBoundary and monitoring service. Whitelist safe fields only. Strip stack traces from external logging.
Review what data is being sent to window.logError. Ensure no PII, auth tokens, or sensitive data is leaked.
Replace Ref-based guard with state-based approach or add timeout reset to prevent potential race conditions.

complianceNotes.csrf: PASS - Middleware validates Origin for state-changing requests
complianceNotes.authentication: PARTIAL - Backend correct, but client-side token passing is broken
complianceNotes.authorization: PASS - RLS enforces data access control at database layer
complianceNotes.inputValidation: PARTIAL - Client-side validation present, server-side validation assumed (need to verify)
complianceNotes.fileUpload: PARTIAL - Client-side MIME check only. Server-side magic-byte check assumed (need to verify)
